critical_code_review_comments: fy.ts uses UTC (getUTCFullYear/getUTCMonth) for FY bucketing but ledger dates like '2026-04-01' are date-only and are parsed as UTC midnight — this is correct and matches the Python mirror. Just be aware: if any future ledger row carries a timezoned datetime near midnight IST on April 1, the UTC vs local-day mismatch could flip its FY. Current data is safe.
party/[id].tsx merges legacy no-currency rows into the INR bucket — matches backend seed behaviour and is exercised by the test suite.
